purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, scope limits, and uncertainty for Kafr Al Sheikh.
assessment: The official Kafr El-Sheikh Governorate portal provides an interactive map and a spatial-services page. The spatial-services form requires login. The official Egyptian Survey Authority documents the national real-estate-register/cadastre program, digital and topographic map services, and Kafr El-Sheikh GIS/state-property work, but no anonymous public parcel-vector endpoint with a safe native ID and geometry was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
registryAssessment: A local governorate service/procedure and national cadastral custodian are evidenced, but no city-bounded open cadastral response is available from the executed anonymous routes; registryFound remains null.

Official project page states that Kafr El-Sheikh is among governorates participating in state-property inventory and mapping/GIS work; no public parcel query or geometry was exposed.
